source: WISE Digital Partners Design System artifact: project/tokens.json, project/README.md, project/assets/wise-logo.png (copied 2026-10-20)

fonts.heading: Montserrat
fonts.note: The brand guide names Proxima Nova for body text, a paid typeface. Montserrat is the approved stand-in until it is licensed; change `body` here then.

usage.body: gray_400 on white and tints (gray_300 is below 4.5:1 for small text)
usage.accent: green, held to one or two moments per slide
usage.dark: gradient_start to gradient_end with white text, for section dividers
